g.text: Current target <=100mA at 5V, to be measured; select declared USB budget before release.

g.desc: Current target <=100mA at 5V, to be measured; select declared USB budget before release.

g.text: Phone-only design; no battery, deuterium lamp or high-power emitter.

g.desc: Phone-only design; no battery, deuterium lamp or high-power emitter.

g.text: Use Kelvin OUTS/COUT and SET-ground return. Keep switch loops away from VIDEO.

g.text: PGFB tied to IN disables fast start; allow SET to settle before exposure.

g.desc: LT3045 - SET and OUTS repaired; output capacitor must retain >=10uF effective capacitance
